decision.title: A Date with Elvis
tracklist: (You're So Square) Baby I Don't Care
I Forgot to Remember to Forget

rationale: Discography populator: full tracklist (10 tracks) per https://www.discogs.com/release/2236589-Elvis-Presley-A-Date-With-Elvis, https://www.rarewaves.com/products/8719262040281-a-date-with-elvis-limited-light-green. 1959 RCA Victor compilation (LPM-2011) of previously unreleased material, released while Presley was in the Army. Tracklist above is the standard US 10-track sequence, identical across Discogs US release, Music on Vinyl reissue listing and RareVinyl UK copy. The UK pressing (RCA RD-27128) carries a different 14-track sequence (adds Tutti Frutti, I'm Gonna Sit Right Down and Cry, I Got a Woman, Blue Moon, Just Because, One-Sided Love Affair, Let Me; omits Young and Beautiful, (You're So Square) Baby I Don't Care, I Want to Be Free).
